Aisha Kapoor: Observed a small but consistent increase in funcall JSON parse errors on the new quantized canary (~0.22%). logs show streaming fragments cut inside escape sequences and occasionally drop a trailing comma, changing semantics.
Tom B: any non-trivial examples?
Aisha Kapoor: sample: 
```
[replica-A] ...\"meta\": {\"note\": \"last seen: 2026-03-21 10:
[replica-B] 42\", \"user\": {\"id\": 77}} ...
```
Naive concat sometimes produces `last seen: 2026-03-21 10:\42"` (bad escape) or leaves a trailing comma that breaks parsers.
Priya Patel: we discussed sentinels/NDJSON earlier. I'd like a low-risk add-on: char-anchor checks. idea: for each replica chunk include a short 4-byte hex anchor derived from the last N chars MD5 (or just CRC32) so the arbiter can detect mid-escape joins. anchors are removed before final parse but used to avoid merging incompatible boundaries.
Jin Park: interesting. flow: model streams chunk -> arbiter appends `|@a:3f4b|` anchor to each fragment metadata header -> when merging we check adjacent anchors; if mismatch, treat as boundary and request merge-fallback. cheap and no contract change to model output.
Tom B: nice. complements TTL (we still keep 150ms) and conservative repair lib. also add a sparse sampled non-streaming retry when anchor mismatch occurs so we can capture true full-response to compare.
Aisha Kapoor: proposal: implement anchors in arbiter for canary 5325000X at 1% traffic, add `anchor_mismatch` telemetry, and enable sampled non-streaming ground-truth fetch for 1/100 anchor mismatches. log original chunks + anchor status to audit queue (scrub PII).
Priya Patel: reassembly lib should first consult anchors; only when anchors indicate a possible safe merge do we attempt balance/quote fixes. repairs remain conservative and logged. emit `repair_skipped_due_to_anchor` metric.
Jin Park: we can implement anchors as CRC32 of last 16 bytes of the chunk; compute on arbiter side without touching model. arbiter tags chunks in metadata stream. caller-side reassembly checks metadata.
Tom B: dashboard items: anchor_mismatch rate, parse_error_rate_post_anchor, repair_skipped_due_to_anchor, sampled_ground_truth_similarity. tag with model+quant+canary.
ops-bot: anchor canary deployed to eng-ml staging (5325000035) 1% traffic.
Aisha Kapoor: runbook summary:
- Add CRC anchors to fragments at arbiter (no model contract change).
- If adjacent anchors mismatch, avoid blind concat; prefer sampled non-streaming fetch and mark for audit.
- Reassembly lib consults anchors before attempting fixes; repairs logged.
- Telemetry: anchor_mismatch, repair_attempted, repair_skipped_due_to_anchor, repair_audit_sampled.
Tom B: I'll add alerts if anchor_mismatch correlates with >0.1% user-facing errors.
Priya Patel: I'll add an offline comparator that uses sampled ground-truth to compute mask_score.
Aisha Kapoor: great, check back with first-hour anchor metrics in this thread. thanks! :thumbsup:
